evidence_slice: The London Borough of Lewisham adopted the Lewisham Local Plan 2020-2040 on 16 July 2025. Policy LWA SA8 is Featherstone Lodge, Eliot Bank. The Inspectors' Report states the site is identified for residential development comprising 33 dwellings; its previous planning permission has lapsed; the existing lodge is intended to be retained while development occurs in the grounds; and the site is developable in the Plan period, scheduled for years 11-15. The current MHCLG Planning Data standardized Lewisham Brownfield Land row FH002 identifies Featherstone Lodge, Eliot Bank, as 0.63 ha, not-permissioned, deliverable, with minimum and maximum net dwellings both 33, and notes Site allocation LWA SA8 with lapsed permission 14/086666.
